about_the_game:
In Phantom Feline, take control of the titular ghost cat with the power to become a sneaky shadow on walls bathed in light.

You can't jump, but by turning into a shadow, you are able to scale walls and move in all directions. You'll use your powers and the many contraptions around you to solve perplexing puzzles and proceed to the next room.

Featuring...

  • The ever so cute and crafty phantom feline!

  • 8 puzzling rooms to solve!

  • Vicious vacuums to avoid!

  • Authentic retro feel! 4-color palette, original sound chip, and authentic aspect ratio to the original Game Boy!

As Featured At...

  • MICA's Baltimore IGDA Multi-School Showcase

  • UMBC Game Developers Club Spring 2025 Game Jam

Credits

Created by members of the UMBC Game Developers Club

  • Design:

    • Game Design: Scott Serafin

    • Level Design: Scott Serafin, Jet Thompson, Aidan Brown, Evan McRae

  • Programming:

    • Jet Thompson, Evan McRae, Aidan Brown, Scott Serafin

  • Art:

    • Scott Serafin

  • Audio:

    • Scott Serafin

    • Evan McRae

  • Tools Used:

    • Early GameBoy Font

    • DOTween

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 300 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Storage: 128 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Can produce radical songz

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11 or newer
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 300 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Can produce awesome beatz

name: Phantom Feline

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 300 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 128 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Can produce epic jamz

short_description: Play with light and shadow in this Game Boy–inspired puzzle game!
